_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. Every key is optional: what
you leave out keeps its default, so a study that matches the defaults
needs no file at all. The dataset dialog in the app writes this file for
you, so editing by hand is a convenience rather than a requirement.
The three MICROBLEED_* environment variables, if set, win over paths
given here -- that is how a launcher opens a second study without

workbook._comment: The sheet the findings are on, and what its columns are called. Only case_id, the three RAS columns and verify are required; leave any other name empty and that column is simply not read.

sequences._comment: Three slots, fixed in number because there are three toolbar buttons and three shortcuts. A sequence is recognised by the END of its filename; everything before it (subject, date, protocol) is free. 'required' false means a case without it still counts as readable. 'segmentable' false means no mask may be drawn on it -- correct for a projection, which smears a lesion along the projection direction.
